metadata.description: This file contains MCQs with validation results from the validation suite.

fields.index: Unique identifier of the MCQ in the dataset
fields.duplicate: Boolean indicating if the MCQ is a duplicate
fields.duplicate_of: List of indices of MCQs that this one duplicates (if any)
fields.options_valid: Boolean indicating if all answer options are valid
fields.options_msg: Message explaining any issues with options
fields.distractor_plausible: Boolean indicating if distractors are plausible
fields.math_physics_valid: Boolean indicating if any math/physics calculations parse correctly
fields.citations_valid: Boolean indicating if citation references are valid
fields.reading_evidence_valid: Boolean indicating if reading-based evidence supports the answer
